verdict.rationale: Jitsu documents its own JavaScript integration (Segment-API compatible) and a React integration for sending events, which are first-party client SDKs. Functions development goes through a CLI/SDK page that scaffolds TypeScript projects. Evidence on SDK breadth and depth is thin. Missing for 10: named SDK packages with reference docs, backend or multi-language SDKs (backends are pointed to the raw HTTP API), a typed SDK for the Management API (OpenAPI spec paths returned 404 when probed), and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Jitsu javascript integration is 100% compatible with Segment API. In addition to that we have React integration
Functions CLI is a tool that allows to develop and deploy Functions to Jitsu.
`jitsu-cli init` scaffolds a TypeScript project with tests, and `jitsu-cli deploy` ships it to your workspace.
